ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is an independently labeled H+; on the left there is a benzene ring connected through a nitrogen atom, appearing as an anilino (phenylamino) part; at the lower right there is another benzene ring, serving as a phenyl substituent; above there is a CO2H carboxylic acid group, and it is connected beside a neighboring carbonyl fragment. The curved arrows indicate electron movement, but the question requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: After ignoring the curved arrows, the main chain can be written starting from the carboxylic acid carbon as O=C(O), then connected to the adjacent ketone carbonyl C(=O), and then connected to the aliphatic chain CC. The terminal benzylic carbon is connected to two substituents: one is Nc1ccccc1, and the other is c1ccccc1. Therefore the neutral molecular part is O=C(O)C(=O)CC(Nc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1. There is also a separate proton in the figure, which needs to be appended as a separated component .[H+].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a molecular graph while ignoring the curved arrows. Identify the left aryl ring attached through nitrogen as an anilino group, identify the right aryl ring as a phenyl substituent, and identify the top substituent as a carboxylic acid attached to a neighboring carbonyl. Traverse the main skeleton from the carboxylic acid carbon through the ketone and aliphatic chain: O=C(O)C(=O)CC(... )..., then add the substituents on the chiral/benzylic carbon as (Nc1ccccc1) and c1ccccc1. Finally append the separate proton as .[H+], yielding O=C(O)C(=O)CC(Nc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1.[H+].
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有一个独立标注的 H+；左侧有一个苯环通过氮原子相连，表现为 anilino（苯胺基）部分；右下方有另一个苯环，作为 phenyl 取代基；上方有 CO2H 羧酸基，并且它连接在邻近的羰基片段旁。弯箭头表示电子移动，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：忽略弯箭头后，主链可从羧酸碳开始写作 O=C(O)，再接相邻酮羰基 C(=O)，然后接脂肪族链 CC。末端的苄位碳连有两个取代基：一个是 Nc1ccccc1，另一个是 c1ccccc1。因此中性分子部分为 O=C(O)C(=O)CC(Nc1ccccc1)c1ccccc1。图中还有单独的质子，需要作为分离组分追加 .[H+]。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the line-angle structure: a carboxylic acid group labeled CO2H attached to an adjacent ketone carbonyl, followed by a carbon chain bearing an anilino substituent on one carbon and a phenyl substituent on the neighboring stereocenter/benzylic carbon; also note the separate proton label H+ near the oxygen. Ignore all curved arrows as requested.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the required output is a SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that the arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard organic line-angle and SMILES conventions: CO2H is C(=O)O, a ketone carbonyl is C(=O), phenyl groups are c1ccccc1, an anilino substituent is Nc1ccccc1, disconnected ions/species are separated with '.', and a free proton is written [H+].
